description: This file defines an internal interface and a class related to version management strategies within the Orleans runtime framework. It handles compatibility and version selector strategies for grain interfaces, including methods for retrieving and setting these strategies, and maintains a state class that stores the strategies. The main class, VersionStoreGrain, implements the IVersionStoreGrain interface and provides async methods to modify and retrieve versioning strategies, integrated with Orleans' storage and grain mechanisms.

classes.name: VersionStoreGrainState
classes.description: Represents the persistent state of the VersionStoreGrain, storing various strategies and overrides related to version management.

classes.name: VersionStoreGrain
classes.description: An Orleans Grain implementing IVersionStoreGrain, managing version compatibility and selector strategies with storage capabilities.

methods.name: SetCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Sets the CompatibilityStrategy override in the state and persists it.

methods.name: SetSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Sets the VersionSelectorStrategy override in the state and persists it.

methods.name: SetCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Sets a CompatibilityStrategy for a specific interface type and persists the change.

methods.name: SetSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Sets a VersionSelectorStrategy for a specific interface type and persists the change.

methods.name: GetCompatibilityStrategies
methods.description: Returns the dictionary of interface-specific CompatibilityStrategies.

methods.name: GetSelectorStrategies
methods.description: Returns the dictionary of interface-specific VersionSelectorStrategies.
